method: the first sheet: locations from the standing pool, colored by a palette-pool draw
why: judged before any finished-render head existed, so nothing could have prefilled it — but its locations came from a pool the location head had already admitted, which is why it is not an instrument

method: the same pool narrowed to locations a human had already called good
why: quality is conditioned on before the page is drawn, by a human rather than a model; what is left to judge is the coloring

method: one location set rendered through the dramatic palette family, at widely varied recipes
why: the recipe axis is the point of it: the palette knobs are drawn wide deliberately, so the tier mix is the draw's and not any population's

method: the same intake colored the way a release run colors it, one render per location
why: same labeling run, same anchoring; a separate registration because the coloring regime is the contrast the pair was built to read

method: locations from the current admitted intake, colored by a pool draw
why: a correction sheet: the incumbent's suggested tier was prefilled and the page ordered by its score, so a rate on it measures agreement with it

method: a bucketed sweep of the intake, one render per location at the incumbent's own best-scoring map
why: anchored twice over: two of its buckets are cut on the incumbent's screen score and every row is the map that head liked best

method: fresh minibrot-centred locations, colored by the release path, served blind in a seeded shuffle
why: THE INSTRUMENT. No suggestion prefilled, no score ordering the page, and no finished-render head anywhere in the draw or the coloring. Bought to referee two heads on unanchored labels, and spent the moment it trains

method: every mandelbrot location the standing offer carries above the junk floor, plus the highest-scoring slice immediately below it, rendered smooth at label fidelity through a palette-head pick
why: the release mix pays mandelbrot the joint-highest ratio in the project on its thinnest supply, and every row it seated in run2 shipped below the advisory. This asks a person what that supply is worth on both sides of the floor the offer cuts at. Cut on the location head's score by construction, and the page prefills this head's own tier and orders the rows by its score, so a rate read on these labels measures agreement with that head and is not a base rate.

method: every smooth row the release path produced across run2, run8h and release_v1 — released and passed over alike — re-rendered at label fidelity through its own recorded recipe
why: the released smooth distribution saturates P(>=3) near 1, so the only column that can order its top end is P(>=4), and no human label has ever been cast against that column on this population. Rows are here for having been colored by a release run, which is a head-driven selection, and the page prefills this head's own tier and orders the rows by its score, so a rate read on these labels measures agreement with that head and is not a base rate.
